provenance_policy: Prefer official mint/central-bank/EU sources. Where an official source establishes the monetary framework but not every physical dimension, CoinBids may store technical specifications cross-checked against multiple public numismatic references and mark source_priority accordingly. Never guess missing specifications.
coverage_notes: Batch 1: standard euro circulation denominations + modern US circulation families.
Batch 2: Greece — major circulation specification families from the LMU/George I era through the final drachma issues, including key silver issues used for melt value.
Not yet exhaustive for all Greek collector/non-circulating issues, ancient coinage, or every 19th-century copper subtype.
Batch 3A: Germany (DEM) official Bundesbank circulation specifications, including the 625‰ silver 5 DM first series; initial Ireland decimal circulation records from Central Bank of Ireland.

Batch 3B: France (FRF) official Légifrance specifications for the principal modern franc families, including 835‰ silver 2 F and 5 F and official 10 F/20 F common-metal types; Spain (ESP) late pre-euro circulation families with BOE framework and cross-checked technical specifications.

Batch 3C: Austria (ATS) detailed official OeNB circulation specifications, including 640‰ silver 5 and 10 Schilling; Finland (FIM) final pre-euro circulation series with Bank of Finland issue framework and cross-checked physical specifications.
Batch 3D: Italy (ITL), Portugal (PTE), Netherlands (NLG), Belgium (BEF). Includes major late pre-euro circulation families and selected post-war silver families with fineness/fine-metal content.

Batch 4A: Slovakia (SKK) complete circulation denomination set from official NBS technical specifications; Cyprus (CYP) official 10, 20 and 50 cent technical specifications. Lower Cyprus denominations remain pending until their physical specifications are directly verified.

Batch 4B: Estonia (EEK) official Eesti Pank circulation specifications; Slovenia (SIT) official Banka Slovenije specifications for 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 tolar circulation coins. Lower stotin denominations and 50 SIT remain pending direct technical verification.

Batch 4C: Latvia (LVL), Lithuania (LTL), Croatia (HRK) and Bulgaria (BGN) major circulation specification families. Official central-bank monetary frameworks are retained in provenance; where individual technical pages were not available, physical specs are marked cross-checked rather than purely official.

Batch 5A: United Kingdom (GBP) decimal circulation specification families, split at major size/composition changes (bronze→plated steel; large→small 5p/10p/50p; round→12-sided £1). Official Royal Mint provenance.

Batch 5B: Switzerland (CHF), Denmark (DKK), Sweden (SEK), Norway (NOK): modern circulation families from official central-bank technical specifications. Historical silver Scandinavian/Swiss families remain for the next historical-metal pass.

Batch 5C historical precious-metal pass: Swiss silver 1/2, 1, 2 and 5 franc families through 1967 plus 1969 5 CHF; Swedish 40% silver 1 and 2 kronor families; Norway 1964 10-kroner .900 commemorative as an explicit variant. Denmark historical silver remains pending issue-level verification rather than being inferred from general monetary history.

Batch 6A: Central Europe — Poland (PLN), Czech Republic (CZK), Hungary (HUF), Romania (RON). Czech and Hungarian current circulation families use direct official central-bank technical parameters; Polish and Romanian material/denomination frameworks are official with physical specs cross-checked where central-bank pages are not fully machine-readable.

Batch 6B Balkans: Serbia (RSD) official NBS circulation families with alloy-era splits for 1/2/5 dinars plus 10/20 dinars; Albania 1 lek exact official technical spec; Bosnia and Herzegovina official composition-only families. Bosnia weight/diameter deliberately left null until directly verified, so these records cannot produce melt value yet.

Batch 6C: Iceland (ISK) official current/historical alloy transitions; Moldova 1 MDL official technical spec; Ukraine major current UAH circulation families plus legacy 1 UAH and early 10 kopiyka. North Macedonia held for next batch pending stronger direct technical-source retrieval.

Batch 7 consolidated gap-closing pass: Malta (MTL), Cyprus cent/mil gaps, Slovenia tolar gaps, North Macedonia (MKD), modern Albania (ALL), and Moldova 2/5/10 MDL. This pass intentionally consolidates several smaller batches into one deliverable.

coverage_plan.principle: Build issue/specification families by composition era, not one row per year. Precious-metal issues get fineness and fine_metal_g.

validation_notes: Year ranges represent specification-family matching windows and should be narrowed further where issue-specific exceptions exist.
Collector/proof precious-metal variants are kept separate from circulation families.
Do not use a family match when a query explicitly names a conflicting variant/type.
metal_value_safety: Precious-metal records require explicit fineness. Commemorative/proof records must remain variant-specific and must not override generic circulation matches unless the query or identification resolves that variant.

data_quality_rules.null_is_allowed: A verified partial record may contain null weight/diameter; never infer missing physical values.
